subject: Fixed-form reference format
notes: kb/Work PB1494 + PB1359 landed both halves: the third floating indicator (the floating literal continuation indicator) is implemented in both reference formats, and a column-7 character that is not a fixed indicator is COBOL2616 (the NIST CCVS letters only under --nist), so the program-text area holds text only 'when the indicator area contains a continuation indicator or a source indicator'.
